title: split durability store into per-domain modules (agents, crdt, workspace_merge)
task_body: convergio-durability::store had grown into a single 1k+ line file. Split it into per-domain submodules (agent_rows + agent_validation + agents; crdt_rows + crdt; workspace_merge_rows + workspace_merge) and re-export from store/mod.rs.
rationale: Pure refactor: every file in store/ that landed in the diff is one slice of the split.
